description: This PHP source file defines the PaymentAddress controller class for the checkout process in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It manages displaying and saving payment address data, including validation, session management, and interaction with address and custom field models.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: Controller class handling the payment address step in checkout, including display, validation, and address management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the payment address form with existing addresses and custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the submitted payment address data, updating session and address records.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets a specific address as the payment address based on address ID.
